bioconda.name: pydivsufsort
bioconda.summary: Python bindings to libdivsufsort (suffix arrays, BWT) and other string algorithms

commands: python -c "from pydivsufsort import divsufsort, kasai; assert divsufsort(\"banana\").tolist() == [5, 3, 1, 0, 4, 2]; assert kasai(\"banana\").tolist() == [1, 3, 0, 0, 2, 0]"
